note: PTSD explicitly indicated.

quote: remission of proteinuria in the nephrotic syndrome, without uremia
note: Uremia appears only as an explicit exclusion from the nephrotic syndrome indication.

quote: aggressive systemic mastocytosis (ASM), systemic mastocytosis with associated haematological neoplasm (SM AHN), or mast cell leukaemia (MCL)

quote: It can be used as a diagnostic aid in such conditions as panhypopituitarism, pituitary dwarfism, ... acromegaly, gigantism
note: Arginine is a diagnostic aid in gigantism, not a treatment.

note: Gonorrhea is a listed indication (with caution against empiric use).

note: Hyperthyroidism is the background for sedation, not the condition treated.

quote: Short- term treatment of active duodenal ulcer

quote: For control of severe nausea and vomiting.
note: Vomiting explicitly indicated.

quote: Acute otitis media caused by Streptococcus pneumoniae
note: Acute otitis media explicitly indicated.

quote: Severe psoriasis.
note: Severe psoriasis listed among dermatologic indications.

note: Nasal congestion relief is attributable to pseudoephedrine as the decongestant.

note: Postherpetic neuralgia is a subtype of neuralgia; near parent.

quote: QULIPTA is indicated for the preventive treatment of migraine in adults.
note: Migraine prevention explicitly indicated.

quote: Prophylaxis of ischemic complications of unstable angina and non-Q-wave myocardial infarction (MI)
note: Unstable angina (intermediate coronary syndrome) is indicated.

quote: indicated for the treatment of pneumonia due to Pneumocystis carinii

quote: may be used in patients with chronic open-angle glaucoma and intraocular hypertension

quote: reduce the risk of myocardial infarction

quote: Familial Mediterranean fever (FMF) in adults and children 4 years or older
note: FMF explicitly indicated.

quote: indicated for the treatment of pulmonary arterial hypertension (PAH, WHO Group I)
